title: Check localized iOS screens with a repeatable Simulator loop
summary: Vladislav R describes checking Office 7’s localized iOS UI with Claude, starting on the smallest screens and comparing screenshots after fixes to labels, line breaks, right-to-left alignment, and number formats. An iOS team can repeat that loop across languages while retaining native-speaker review, which he notes remains necessary in the thread.
takeaway: Check small-screen layouts across languages, rerun the same screens after fixes, and pair agent screenshot comparison with review by speakers of the target language.

media.alt: Office 7 source screenshots comparing Japanese, Vietnamese, Chinese, and Hebrew localized screens
